scope: One corrected external Android memory-cover-settings case against the retained APK. Exact original sign-in and source unchanged. Verify committed save, correct owner/book/revision/title and ordered readback using restored runner gate.
apkIntegrity: Pinned artifact ID, source receipt, binary manifest, audit manifest and APK digests. Original tracked checkout must remain clean. Installed base APK bytes are read back and hashed before UI testing.
runtimeEnvironment: Disposable Ubuntu24 Android35 AOSP x86_64 emulator with known working Mesa LLVMpipe GLES setup;25minute total job cap;180second owned Maestro case deadline.
limits: No app build, rebundle, resign, remote write or runtime acceptance performed during preparation.
Does not verify the current appearance/offer/story/poll/reader code changes on a device.
Synthetic fixture persistence is verified; no hosted database or provider mutation is performed.
cleanupRefinement: The owned emulator receives TERM, a2second bounded wait, then KILL before reaping. This avoids an unbounded EXIT trap delaying artifact upload.
